sections.ayurvedic_treatment_of_herpes_zostere:
About Herpes Zoster 
 Herpes zoster (Shingles) is an infection that results in the formation of painful red skin rashes due to reactivation of Varicella-Zoster Virus from its latent state present in a posterior dorsal root ganglion. Any person who suffered from chickenpox or received chickenpox vaccine in the past may possibly develop shingles. 
 Even children can get shingles. However, the probability of getting the disease increases with increasing age, generally above 60 years. Symptoms usually begin with pain and followed by rashes in 2 to 3 days by a vesicular eruption that is usually diagnostic.

Ultimately, the virus may get reactivated and result in a second encounter called herpes zoster or shingles.
sections.age_factor_older_than_50_the_risk_increa:

 Radiation or chemotherapy during cancer can lower your resistance to diseases and may trigger shingles.

 Emotional stress and trauma.

 In this disease, the pitta dosha is responsible for the eruption of reddish painful boils in the hands, armpit, shoulders, eyes and waist. 
 The disease eruptions peculiarly occur in a single line resembling the sacred thread (yagyopaveet) hence it has been named Zoster.

sections.complications_of_herpes_zoster:
Post-herpetic neuralgia happens when damaged nerve fibers send confused and exaggerated messages of pain from your skin to your brain. 
 Vision loss: When shingles appear in or around an eye (ophthalmic shingles) can cause painful eye infections, causing loss of vision. 
 Neurological problems. Depending on the nerves affected, shingles might lead to inflammation of the brain (encephalitis), facial paralysis, hearing loss or balance problems. 
 Skin infections: If shingles blisters are not controlled it may result in bacterial skin infections. 

 Measures to prevent others from Herpes Zoster Infection 

 Keep the rashes covered. 
 Try to make least scratching or contact with the rash. 
 Regular hand-washing should be kept as a habit. 
 Avoid any contact with pregnant women who never suffered from chickenpox or even had varicella vaccine. 
 Avoid contact with Premature or low birth weight infants. 

 Certain Herbs Useful in Herpes Zoster Infection 

 Lemon Herb – A cup of herbal tea prepared by adding a few leaves of lemon herb, is found effective in shingles infection. 
 Chamomile – It is an antiviral herb and chamomile bath can be very beneficial to get relief from the symptoms of shingles infection. 
 Mullein – Leaves as well flowers of this herb provide relief from pain caused due to shingles.
